title: RetailFlex Decision Studio
claim_boundary: All cases are simulated screening scenarios for a representative SuperMarket prototype. They are not calibrated to, validated for, or authorized to control any Walmart store.

scenarios.label: Illustrative thermal shift
scenarios.description: Each day, reduce the shared cooling setpoint by 1.0 degC from 12:00-15:00 and increase it by 1.0 degC from 15:00-18:00. This is an illustrative screening intervention, not an operating recommendation.

scenarios.label: Thermal shift plus illustrative lighting reduction
scenarios.description: Thermal-shift case plus a 20% reduction to the prototype interior-lighting schedule from 15:00-18:00. This excludes visual-task, merchandising, safety, and operational review.
